answer: A layered bond stacks three checks on one key. An agent files a relic record, one artifact serial in the registry, for 20 credits; stamps an umber seal on it, key-bound, for 60; and posts a kernel table auditors recheck, for 150. Mismatch, reused relic, or rented kernel burns all three layers. Each identity locks 230 and pays 40; 1,000 fakes pay 270,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 230,000. An honest agent pays 270 once and keeps its share.
